markup:
To run an entire house on a **solar generator**, you'll typically need a system with **10–30 kWh of battery storage** and **5–15 kW of continuous power output**. The exact size depends on whether you want to run essential appliances or everything, including air conditioning.

## Recommended solar generator sizes

| Home usage | Battery capacity | Inverter output |
|---|---|---|
| Essentials only (fridge, lights, Wi-Fi) | 3–5 kWh | 2–3 kW |
| Small house, limited AC | 5–10 kWh | 3–6 kW |
| Average house, most appliances | 10–20 kWh | 6–10 kW |
| Whole house with central AC | 20–40 kWh | 10–15 kW |
| Large all-electric house | 40–60+ kWh | 15–25+ kW |

These are approximate starting points for backup power, not guaranteed 24-hour runtimes.

## Example: Average American house

Suppose your house consumes 30 kWh per day.

<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={2}>
  <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="xs">ESTIMATED BATTERY RUNTIME</text>
  {@body const [capacity,setCapacity] = DIL.useState(20)}
  {@body const [usage,setUsage] = DIL.useState(30)}
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    **Battery capacity**
    <title size="lg" color="default" tabularNums>{capacity} kWh</title>
  </row>
  <slider min={5} max={60} step={5} value={capacity} onChange={setCapacity}/>
  <row align="center" justify="between">
    **Daily household consumption**
    <title size="lg" color="default" tabularNums>{usage} kWh</title>
  </row>
  <slider min={10} max={80} step={5} value={usage} onChange={setUsage}/>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <grid columns={2} gap={3}>
    <grid-item>
      <text color="secondary" size="xs">Estimated runtime</text>
      <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{(capacity*0.9/usage*24).toFixed(1)} hours</title>
    </grid-item>
    <grid-item>
      <text color="secondary" size="xs">Daily energy covered</text>
      <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{Math.round(capacity*0.9/usage*100)}%</title>
    </grid-item>
  </grid>
  <caption>Assumes 90% usable delivered battery energy, no solar recharging, and steady average consumption. Actual runtime varies with appliance use.</caption>
</box>

## Solar panels needed

If you also want to recharge your batteries daily using solar power:

| Daily electricity usage | Approximate solar array |
|---|---|
| 10 kWh | 3–4 kW |
| 20 kWh | 5–7 kW |
| 30 kWh | 8–10 kW |
| 50 kWh | 13–16 kW |

Actual solar production depends on location, season, weather, roof orientation, and shading. Winter and cloudy-day backup may require more panels or batteries.

## Examples of whole-house-capable systems

<row gap={3} align="start">
  <AsyncImage query="EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra home battery inverter solar generator" aspectRatio="4:5" maxWidth="132px" shop_eligible={true}/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity category="product" value="EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra" disambig="Expandable home backup battery system"/>**

    Modular home backup system with 6 kWh battery modules and 7.2 kW inverter output per inverter. Multiple units can be combined for larger homes.
  </box>
</row>
<divider color="subtle"/>
<row gap={3} align="start">
  <AsyncImage query="Anker SOLIX F3800 portable power station solar generator" aspectRatio="4:5" maxWidth="132px" shop_eligible={true}/>
  <box flex="1" gap={1}>
    **<Entity category="product" value="Anker SOLIX F3800" disambig="Expandable portable home backup power station"/>**

    Starts at 3.84 kWh of storage with 6 kW AC output. Expandable for longer backup runtimes.
  </box>
</row>

For whole-house operation, you also need compatible electrical integration, such as a transfer switch or home backup panel, installed appropriately.

## Three questions to size your system

{@body const [home,setHome] = DIL.useState("2000–3000 sq ft")}
{@body const [ac,setAc] = DIL.useState("Central AC")}
{@body const [goal,setGoal] = DIL.useState("24-hour backup")}
<box border radius="xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <form gap={3} onSubmit={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn("Size a solar generator for my house. House size: "+home+". Cooling: "+ac+". Goal: "+goal+". Recommend battery capacity, inverter power, and solar panel wattage.")}>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>1. How big is your house?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={home} onChange={setHome}>
        <radio value="Under 1500 sq ft">Under 1,500 sq ft</radio>
        <radio value="1500–2000 sq ft">1,500–2,000 sq ft</radio>
        <radio value="2000–3000 sq ft">2,000–3,000 sq ft</radio>
        <radio value="Over 3000 sq ft">Over 3,000 sq ft</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>2. Do you need to run air conditioning?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={ac} onChange={setAc}>
        <radio value="No AC">No</radio>
        <radio value="Window AC or mini split">Window AC / mini split</radio>
        <radio value="Central AC">Central AC</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <box gap={1}>
      <label>3. What's your goal?</label>
      <radio-group direction="col" value={goal} onChange={setGoal}>
        <radio value="24-hour backup">24-hour backup during outages</radio>
        <radio value="Multi-day backup">Multiple days of backup</radio>
        <radio value="Off-grid full time">Run the house completely off-grid</radio>
      </radio-group>
    </box>
    <button block submit>Calculate my recommended system <icon name="arrow-right" inline/></button>
  </form>
</box>

The difference between powering a house for one day and running it entirely off-grid is substantial, so that last question is especially important.
